ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِۨ الْآمِرِ بِالْعَدْلِ وَ النَّاهِيْ عَنِ التَّفْرِيْطِ وَ الْإِفْرَاطِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Āli Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, Al-Āmiri bi ‘l-`adli wa ‘n-nāhī `ani ‘t-tafrīṭi wa ‘l-ifrāṭ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad the instructor of justice and preventer of excess and immoderation!
blocks.review: وَعَلَى أٰلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ is printed in white (wrapped in em), followed by a small detached white nūn (tanwīn marker), transcribed as U+06E8.

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ وَ سَلِّمْنَا بِبَرَكَتِهِ مِنَ الْاِنْحِطَاطِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Āli Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, Wa sallimnā bi barakati hī min ‘l-inḥiṭāṭ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad and safeguard us by his blessing from inferiority!
blocks.review: وَعَلَى أٰلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ is printed in white (wrapped in em); مُحَمَّدِ shows a single kasra and no small nūn here.
